cues: And so transition metals run industry.

Iron for ammonia, vanadium pentoxide for sulphuric acid, platinum and rhodium gauze for nitric acid, nickel for vanaspati ghee, manganese dioxide for oxygen in the lab, and Ziegler Natta catalysts of titanium for polythene.
